text:
Lina: Quick UX thread 1: stacktrace area in drilldown. Proposal: add a small "copy" affordance that copies the visible frames + context table. Should copy as plain text by default, with a kebab offering JSON/ZIP export. Thoughts?
Evan: yes for copy button. For exports, prefer "Download stacktrace (JSON)" and "Download harvest (HAR/zip)" as separate actions. users often paste plain text into tickets.
Priya: agree. small concern: copying multiline stacktrace needs a clear delimiter so pasted content doesn't break parsers. maybe prefix with "-- Stacktrace: <corr-id> --" and timestamp.
Zoe: +1 on delimiter. Also suggest including a short header when copying: product name, request id, corr id, short URL to trace. helps triage.
Lina: good. keyboard/hover behavior? I'd like copy to be visible on hover and focus only to reduce noise. show icons inline but hidden until hover/focus.
Evan: hover-only is fine, but we need to ensure keyboard users can discover it. make it tabbable and included in tab order after frames.
Priya: accessibility: copying should announce via aria-live region "Stacktrace copied to clipboard" instead of only a toast, because screen reader users won't see visual toasts.
design-bot: Accessibility guidance: implement aria-live="polite" sink for copy confirmations, and ensure the copy control has aria-label and role="button". Example: <button aria-label="Copy stacktrace for request 4c3b">Copy</button>. Avoid title-only.
Zoe: another a11y note: if we collapse frames into "Show more frames" then the control needs aria-expanded and the frame count in sr-only text.
Evan: performance: rendering full stackframes for 10k rows will be heavy. we should virtualize frames and only render actions for visible rows. Also consider a single shared copy action in the header for bulk copy of selected rows.
Lina: bulk-copy in header is great. UX for selection: checkboxes per row, keyboard-select all with shift+click, and clear selection after download.
Priya: copy format suggestion: plain text block + JSON option with metadata. Example plain text: 
```
-- Stacktrace (corr: 4c3b) 2025-03-18T13:22:11Z --
Error: foo
  at server.js:45
  at lib/request.js:200
-- end --
```
Evan: good. Also for exported filename use pattern: stacktrace-<corrid>-<shortts>.txt or .json. avoids collisions.
Zoe: microcopy: use "Copy stacktrace" for button label, "Download JSON" and "Download text" in kebab. Keep verbs consistent (Copy/Download).
Lina: decision draft: inline copy button visible on hover/focus; tabbable after frames; aria-live confirmation message; kebab contains Download JSON / Download text / Export HAR; header action for bulk download when rows selected; filenames include corr id + short ts; copy payload includes header delimiter and trace permalink.
Priya: also add 300ms debounce on export action to prevent duplicate network calls.
Evan: dev note: will lazy-load full frame content on expand to avoid initial payload.
Zoe: a11y polish: focus styles must be high contrast and visible when motion reduced. add focus-visible from design tokens.
design-bot: Accessibility checklist added to ticket: aria-labels, aria-live copy confirmations, aria-expanded on show-more, keyboard order rules, focus-visible token.
Lina: Action items:
- Evan: implement copy + kebab export options + virtualize frames (PR by Wed)
- Priya: write copy examples and clipboard header templates (by Tue)
- Zoe: add focus-visible token & collapse/expand aria spec to Figma (by Mon)
- Lina: update RD-7123 with decision text and link examples
Evan: I'll link demo when ready.
Priya: tagging QA for clipboard & screen reader tests.
Lina: thanks all :sparkles:
